name: National Governors Association Former Governors Search
license: Association website; verify reuse terms before redistribution
notes: Structured historical index with governor name, jurisdiction, party, years in office, and profile URL. The NGA is an association rather than a federal agency; treat this as a curated reference source and reconcile against state archives for authoritative completeness.

name: Federal Register Presidential Memoranda and Determinations
notes: Keyless API collection of presidential memoranda, determinations, and other presidential documents, with official document links and agency metadata.

name: Federal Register Presidential Proclamations
notes: Presidential proclamation metadata with dates, titles, order numbers where available, abstracts, presidents, and official document links.

name: Federal Register Executive Orders
notes: Executive-order metadata and links to official HTML/JSON records; fetched with pagination and preserved with retrieval metadata.

name: American Community Survey 5-Year Profile
notes: Demographic, socioeconomic, household, housing, and population profile variables. The public API currently returns a missing-key response for data queries in this environment; use a Census API key or the downloadable summary files for ingestion.

name: Federal Register Agency Catalog
notes: Agency names, slugs, descriptions, parent/child relationships, and Federal Register publication metadata. Includes historical and component agencies represented in the Federal Register.

name: U.S. Presidents in the Census Records
notes: Chronological presidential service dates, including non-consecutive service as separate records.

name: Current and Historical Congressional Legislators
license: Project license; inspect upstream terms before redistribution
notes: Open normalized member, identifier, and term records for current and historical U.S. Representatives and Senators.

name: Census Place Population Estimates, 2020-2024
notes: Annual estimates for Census places, including incorporated places and census-designated places.

name: Census County Population Estimates, 2020-2024
notes: Annual county population estimates with demographic components and group-quarters estimates.

name: 2020 TIGER Congressional District Attributes
format: Shapefile ZIP; attributes extracted to JSON
notes: 116th Congress boundary vintage. Geometry remains available from the source archive.

name: 2020 Census Gazetteer Place Files
notes: Census place identifiers, names, area, and representative coordinates.

name: GNIS Populated Places
publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / Board on Geographic Names
notes: Official populated-place names, feature IDs, counties, and coordinates.

name: GNIS Domestic Names
publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / Board on Geographic Names
notes: Official and variant geographic names; national download is large and should be ingested selectively by feature class.

name: 2020 TIGER/Line Congressional Districts
notes: Historical boundary vintage; later vintages should be added as separate releases.

name: 2020 Census ZCTA Gazetteer
notes: 2020 five-digit ZCTA identifiers, area, and representative coordinates.

name: 2020 ZCTA-to-County Relationship File
notes: Geographic intersections only; not an allocation or postal delivery equivalence.

name: Census State Reference File
notes: State and territory abbreviations, FIPS codes, and ANSI state codes.

name: 2023 Census Gazetteer County Files
notes: County GEOIDs, names, land/water area, and representative coordinates.

name: Census Population Estimates by State
notes: Annual state population estimates; preserve vintage and retrieval date.

name: Census Gazetteer State Files
notes: Geographic reference files; population counts are not included.

name: Senators of the United States, 1789-Present
notes: Historical chronology; use for validation against member-level records.

name: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
notes: ZCTAs are statistical approximations of USPS ZIP service areas, not postal delivery boundaries.
